paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Behavior of In Situ Intermetallic Composites Cr-Cr2Hf

evidence.quote: A detailed investigation of the effects of microstructural changes on the mechanical behavior of two in situ intermetallic composites with Cr and Cr2Hf phases in the Cr-Hf system was performed.
